limitations: One new family: class-header interface delegation. Existing property delegation, source classifiers/generics and ordinary interface implementation remain prerequisites. Saved private-final-synthetic receivers, one evaluation after super construction and before property/init execution, disjoint multiple delegates, explicit overrides, interface getter/setter forwarding, generic substitution/erased bridges and delegated Kotlin member metadata are covered.

Public top-level interfaces and ordinary top-level delegators; invariant Kotlin interface parameters and nongeneric Java scalar/reference contracts. Default bodies, internal/nested/dollar-named classifier/type shapes, delegating objects/data classes/enums/secondary constructors/explicit superclass combinations, decorated/generic/extension/renamed/vararg/default-argument members, complex overlapping erased signatures and Java generic/raw/reference-array member types remain explicit boundaries. Extra private saved fields are permitted; final constructor backing-field reuse is not an optimization goal.

Fixed Java assertions compile once against official and execute against both outputs with verification. Separate official Kotlin consumers and metadata flag/ABI checks. Original upstream multi-module files/directives are preserved. Pinned PSI inventory establishes zero AndroidBible header delegation uses; no new app-file, APK/device/full-app, performance or complete Kotlin claim.
